WikiPage

WikiPage.Rd

Represents a Wiki Page.

Usage

WikiPage(id=NULL, etag=NULL, title=NULL, parent_id=NULL, markdown=NULL, attachments=list(), owner_id=NULL, created_on=NULL, created_by=NULL, modified_on=NULL, modified_by=NULL, wiki_version=NULL, markdown_file_handle_id=NULL, attachment_file_handle_ids=list())

Format

An S3-style class object.

Arguments

id

(Optional[str]) The unique identifier for this wiki page.

etag

(Optional[str]) The etag of this object. Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme to handle concurrent updates. Since the E-Tag changes every time an entity is updated it is used to detect when a client's current representation of an entity is out-of-date.

title

(Optional[str]) The title of this page.

parent_id

(Optional[str]) When set, the WikiPage is a sub-page of the indicated parent WikiPage.

markdown

(Optional[str]) The markdown content of the wiki page.

attachments

(list[dict[str, Any]]) A list of file attachments associated with the wiki page.

owner_id

(Optional[str]) The Synapse ID of the owning object (e.g., entity, evaluation, etc.).

created_on

(Optional[str]) The timestamp when this page was created.

created_by

(Optional[str]) The ID of the user that created this page.

modified_on

(Optional[str]) The timestamp when this page was last modified.

modified_by

(Optional[str]) The ID of the user that last modified this page.

wiki_version

(Optional[str]) The version number of this wiki page.

markdown_file_handle_id

(Optional[str]) The ID of the file handle containing the markdown content.

attachment_file_handle_ids

(list[str]) The list of attachment file handle ids of this page.

Value

NULL

Methods

  • WikiPage(id=NULL, etag=NULL, title=NULL, parent_id=NULL, markdown=NULL, attachments=list(), owner_id=NULL, created_on=NULL, created_by=NULL, modified_on=NULL, modified_by=NULL, wiki_version=NULL, markdown_file_handle_id=NULL, attachment_file_handle_ids=list()): Constructor for WikiPage

  • synCopy(instance, destination_owner_id, destination_sub_page_id=NULL, update_links=TRUE, entity_map=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Copy the wiki page tree of the owner entity to another entity and update internal links.

    If id is set on this WikiPage, only the sub-tree rooted at that wiki page is copied. Otherwise the entire wiki of the owner entity is copied.

  • synGetAttachment(instance, file_name, download_file=TRUE, download_location=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Download the wiki page attachment to a local file or return the URL.

  • synGetAttachmentHandles(instance, synapse_client=NULL): Get the file handles of all attachments on this wiki page.

  • synGetAttachmentPreview(instance, file_name, download_file=TRUE, download_location=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Download the wiki page attachment preview to a local file or return the URL.

  • synGetMarkdownFile(instance, download_file=TRUE, download_location=NULL, synapse_client=NULL): Get the markdown URL of this wiki page.

  • synReformatAttachmentFileName(attachment_file_name): Reformat the attachment file name to be a valid attachment path.

  • synRestore(instance, synapse_client=NULL): Restore a specific version of a wiki page.

  • synUnzipGzippedFile(file_path): Unzip the gzipped file and return the file path to the unzipped file. If the file is a markdown file, the content will be printed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Store a wiki page
    # This example shows how to store a wiki page.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    project = Project(name = "My uniquely named project about Alzheimer's Disease") |> synGet()
    wiki_page = WikiPage(owner_id = project$id, title = "My wiki page") |> synStore()
    print(wiki_page)

## Example 2: Get a wiki page from Synapse
    # This example shows how to get a wiki page from Synapse.
    # It uses the project and wiki_page from Example 1.
    wiki_page = WikiPage(owner_id = project$id, id = wiki_page$id) |> synGet()
    print(wiki_page)

## Example 3: Delete a wiki page
    # This example shows how to delete a wiki page.
    # It uses the project and wiki_page from Example 1.
    WikiPage(owner_id = project$id, id = wiki_page$id) |> synDelete()
    print("Wiki page deleted successfully.")
} # }
